method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited texts with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied (the injured worker, and on death the dependants), with further seats for the insurer and the employer, on whom the 1998 Act and the Regulation put real duties; design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18: a seat-neutral core (nsw-wc-core.l4, with 13 regulative rules for the duties and deadlines of the worker, the employer and the insurer) and three seat layers that restate no rule; indexed amounts are MAYBE inputs defaulting to the figure the deposited text states; no REFUSE (a case outside the encoding answers `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Workers Compensation Act 1987 No 70 (corpus version nsw_legislation:2023-10-30/act-1987-070), Workplace Injury Management and Workers Compensation Act 1998 No 86 (nsw_legislation:2024-07-01/act-1998-086) and Workers Compensation Regulation 2016 (nsw_legislation:2024-07-24/sl-2016-0559), each from the Open Australian Legal Corpus 7.1.0 as at 10 March 2025, deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-1987-070.txt, ../../../workplace-injury-management-and-workers-compensation-act-1998/registers/source-bundle/act-1998-086.txt and ../../../workers-compensation-regulation-2016/registers/source-bundle/sl-2016-0559.txt. NOT the current official text; it may be out of date. No SIRA indexation order is deposited, and the corpus dropped the formulas (s 66(2)(a)-(b), ss 80, 82A, 82B, 82BA, 82F).

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run nsw-wc-core.l4 ; l4 run nsw-wc-seat.l4 ; l4 run nsw-wc-seat-insurer.l4 ; l4 run nsw-wc-seat-employer.l4 ; l4 run nsw-wc-cases-worker.l4 ; l4 run nsw-wc-cases-insurer.l4 ; l4 run nsw-wc-cases-employer.l4
checks.result: 280 assertions satisfied (worker 194/194, insurer 49/49, employer 37/37), 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-10-24, re-run after the corrections of NOTES.md findings 16-19; the first run had 260, all satisfied); 24 #TRACEs with an expect line (18 breaches, 6 obligations or permissions still open), each read and as expected
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: Compensation for a NSW worker injured on or after 21 October 2019. In: 1987 Act weekly payments (s 32A entitlement periods and high/highest needs; s 33; s 34(1AA), (1); ss 36, 37; s 38(1)-(7); s 38A(1); s 39; s 52; Sch 3 cl 2(1), (2), (4) with Regulation cl 8AB, cl 8; s 82A as a declared factor with s 82C(a)); medical s 59A; death s 25(1), (2), (4), (5), s 26, s 29(1)-(1B); permanent impairment s 66(1), (1A), (2)(c)-(h), (2A), (3); 1998 Act duties and deadlines (regulative): s 44(1), (2), (4), ss 48, 48A, 49, 254, 261, 264(1), (2), (4), ss 266-269, s 274(1)-(4) with ss 275(2), 276(1), 283(1); Regulation cl 35(1)-(3), cl 36, Schedule 5 (penalty notice amounts, in the consequences). Not covered (asserted): the s 66(2)(a)-(b) formulas for 11-50% impairment (missing from the deposit); injuries or deaths before 21 October 2019; police officers, paramedics, firefighters and coal miners (Schedule 6); PIAWE details under Regulation Part 4 Division 2 beyond an input; anything needing the Workers Compensation Guidelines (inputs). Out: work injury damages and common law (1987 Act Part 5; 1998 Act s 262); commutation (Division 9); s 60 beyond the s 59A period; ss 64B-64C; ss 40, 41, 53, 57; disputes and the Personal Injury Commission; premiums, costs, insurer licensing. Read with subjects/au/social-security-act-1991/ (s 23(5A)-(5D) pension age, the s 52 retiring age; Part 3.14 compensation recovery, unverified), subjects/au/income-tax-assessment-act-1997/ (assessability of weekly payments, unverified), subjects/au/fair-work-act-2009/ (s 32A fair work instrument) and subjects/au/nsw/victims-rights-and-support-regulation-2019/ (cl 9 uses the pre-2012 s 37, not in this deposit); cross-folder IMPORT is not possible.
seats: the injured worker (and, on the worker's death, the worker's dependants)
